If sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.7) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.7) in the last 3 days, decrease forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid bearish overcorrection.

If sentiment is neutral (±0.3) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to prevent over-optimism.

If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, increase forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment turns positive after a negative streak (last 3 days), add 2–3% to forecast at late horizon (16–30 days) to reflect sentiment reversal.

If sentiment turns negative after a positive streak, subtract 2–3% from forecast at late horizon (16–30 days) to reflect sentiment correction.
